record_title: Deflation-history contamination can make weighted-mass ACA arbitrarily suboptimal
provenance: Analytic counterexample and residual-state analysis for the weighted-mass diagonal ACA rule introduced in arXiv:2609.17947, compared with residual-dependent pivoted-Cholesky and SPSD cross-approximation literature.
limitations: The counterexample is synthetic and positive semidefinite but singular, and it is not shown to arise from the radial-basis Galerkin matrices used in the motivating experiments. The theorem concerns fixed-rank approximation quality rather than eventual convergence, uses the self-containing neighborhood convention indicated by the source paper's one-neighbor description, and does not establish a general convergence theorem for the proposed residual-consistent alternative. A broad older pivoted-Cholesky literature remains a residual originality risk for more abstract formulations.
